articles.summary: Allegro announced a groundbreaking series of Power products poised to redefine performance and efficiency across automotive, industrial and data center applications.
articles.title: Allegro MicroSystems Unveils Innovative Power Products for a More Energy Efficient Future

articles.summary: Discover the A81415 safety PMIC from Allegro. Single-chip ASIL-D power and wheel-speed sensing designed to simplify and optimize brake-by-wire corner modules.
articles.title: Allegro MicroSystems Unveils Industry's First Safety PMIC to Integrate a Wheel-Speed Sensor Interface for Electromechanical Braking

articles.summary: Allegro MicroSystems, today at Electronica 2024, introduced its new inductive position sensors and a series of micropower magnetic switches and latches
articles.title: Allegro MicroSystems Introduces Advanced Magnetic and Inductive Position Sensing Solutions at Electronica 2024

articles.summary: Allegro MicroSystems, Inc. today announced the launch of the third product in its High Voltage Power-Thru™ portfolio. Allegro’s two-chip AHV85000 and AHV85040 isolated gate-driver IC solutions
articles.title: Allegro MicroSystems Expands Isolated Gate Driver Portfolio with Power-Thru Combo Chip

articles.summary: Allegro MicroSystems Inc., today announced that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Crocus Technology for $420 million in cash.
articles.title: Allegro MicroSystems Completes Acquisition of Crocus Technology to Accelerate innovation in TMR Sensing Technology

articles.summary: Experience the future of electric vehicles with GHSP's innovative eVibe system, crafted in collaboration with Allegro, a leader in power and sensing semiconductor technology.
articles.title: GHSP Leverages Allegro MicroSystems’ Technology to Shift the Future of Electric Vehicles with the Introduction of New eVibe System

articles.summary: New current sensors utilizing Allegro’s patented XtremeSense™ TMR technology represent the first products launched since the company’s acquisition of Crocus Technologies.
articles.title: Allegro MicroSystems Introduces High-Bandwidth Current Sensors Incorporating XtremeSense™ TMR Technology

articles.summary: Allegro MicroSystems today announced that its A89224 automotive System-on-a-Chip (SoC) has won the Electronica 2024: Best-in-Show Award.
articles.title: Allegro MicroSystems Wins Embedded Computing Design’s Electronica 2024: Best-In-Show Award

articles.summary: Allegro MicroSystems today announced that BMW Group has selected Allegro as the sole Current Sensor IC supplier for their traction inverter systems.
articles.title: Allegro MicroSystems and BMW Group Collaborate on High Efficiency Traction Inverters for Battery Electric Vehicles
